props.caption: A locked IPO allocation routes future model work and robot purchases toward the same vendor queue.

items.note: A worker grounded an explosive-armed quadcopter inside the airport cargo area before investigators could name an operator or state sponsor.
Google broke ground on a gigawatt-scale AI hub whose three campuses now sit inside separate land, water and wildlife-permission disputes.
DeepSeek took a locked Unitree allocation and reciprocal vendor preferences without a joint model, pilot or data loop.
Assam’s late bulletin counted 97 seasonal flood deaths and 168,701 affected people while fresh embankment breaches cut village roads.
SpaceX and Tesla announced a $16.8 billion semiconductor complex while an earlier filing kept a much larger initial-capital figure unresolved.

items.kicker: Terafab Arrives With Two Capital Figures
items.what: SpaceX and Tesla put an initial $16.8 billion behind a Grimes County chip complex. An earlier filing described $55 billion as initial investment, and no public document had reconciled the phase definitions by cutoff.

ASDMA’s late count reached 97 seasonal deaths, 168,701 affected people and 15 districts. Breaches around Darrang and Udalguri shifted the burden from aggregate water levels to broken local roads and embankments.

items.kicker: Congo’s Export Wall Has a Waiver Door
items.what: Congo barred copper and cobalt concentrate exports while preserving one-year waivers for strategic circumstances. The unpublished waiver list will decide how much material the order actually stops.

items.kicker: Uganda Authorises an Unwritten Gaza Mission
items.what: Parliament cleared a stabilisation deployment without publishing the force size, departure date, command chain, funding or casualty-evacuation plan.

items.kicker: Whoosh Moves Its Debt Closer to Treasury
items.what: Indonesia plans to transfer the state consortium’s 60% railway stake to a finance-ministry agency. Officials ruled out budget spending while giving the agency responsibility for the loans.

Morocco offered cooperation on identifying and returning unaccompanied minors after the crossing. Roughly 1,100 children still faced family tracing, guardianship and best-interest reviews rather than an automatic return.

items.kicker: Europe’s Heat Reaches the Cooling Water
items.what: Low Danube and Rhine levels constrained nuclear cooling and freight loads as governments dimmed public lighting and prepared emergency water works.

items.kicker: OpenClaw Hid the Operator’s Last Word
items.what: A reproducible Workboard bug displayed Operator Notes in the control panel while omitting them from the agent’s effective prompt. The model obeyed the context it received; the interface implied a different one.
